edges.reason: msg.sender is forwarded as the from argument of _transfer.
msg.sender becomes the owner argument of _approve via approve.
msg.sender is used as spender when consuming allowance in transferFrom.
onlyOwner compares the caller-controlled address with _owner.
manualswap requires msg.sender to equal the privileged fee wallet.
manualsend requires msg.sender to equal the privileged fee wallet.
Cooldown window is derived from miner-influenced block.timestamp.
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline.
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
transfer delegates to the private _transfer.
transferFrom delegates to the private _transfer.
transferFrom updates allowance through _approve.
approve delegates to the private _approve.
_transfer conditionally calls swapTokensForEth when swapEnabled.
_transfer conditionally calls sendETHToFee with the contract ETH balance.
_transfer finishes by calling _tokenTransfer.
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap.
sendETHToFee executes the raw ETH transfer to the fee wallet.
setCooldownEnabled is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
renounceOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
openTrading is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
setBots is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
delBot is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
openTrading calls addLiquidityETH with the contract ETH balance.
openTrading calls the factory createPair.
openTrading issues an unbounded approval of the pair.
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth on the contract balance.
manualsend calls sendETHToFee on the contract ETH balance.
_tokenTransfer forwards to _transferStandard.
_transferStandard obtains fee breakdown from _getValues.
_transferStandard credits the team share via _takeTeam.
_transferStandard applies the fee via _reflectFee.
_getValues calls _getTValues for token-side values.
_getValues calls _getRValues for reflection-side values.
_getValues reads the current rate.
_getRate derives the rate from _getCurrentSupply.
balanceOf converts reflections using tokenFromReflection.
ETH transfer to the fee wallet executes before _transfer returns, allowing reentrant calls.
manualsend performs a state-changing ETH transfer that can re-enter the contract.
Payable addLiquidityETH forwards ETH to an external router mid-execution of openTrading.
External router swap is executed while _transfer is still running.
_rOwned entries are read and rewritten by _transferStandard.
_reflectFee subtracts rFee from _rTotal.
Blacklist state is read by the bots check in _transfer.
Cooldown mapping is read and written against block.timestamp in _transfer.
manualswap authorization reads the stored fee wallet address.
sendETHToFee transfers ETH to the stored fee wallet address.
swapTokensForEth uses the stored router for WETH and approvals.
_transfer reads uniswapV2Pair to detect buy/sell directions.
_maxTxAmount caps the amount in the cooldown branch.
